speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you have a history of fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. Did you experience any burning sensation during urination or notice changes in the color or frequency of your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming. To better understand the connection between your sinus infection and your current symptoms, did you notice any blood in your urine, or have you recently developed nausea or vomiting? Also, please tell me if you have any known kidney stones or past urinary tract infections.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis (likely secondary to a superinfection or incomplete treatment of the initial UTI, exacerbated by antibiotic selection history).

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, Complete Blood Count (CBC), and Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
REQUEST IMAGES: Renal Ultrasound.
